name: glow-border
title: Glow Border
description: The edge of a card lights up nearest the pointer, as if the pointer were a lamp held close to it; the light fades along the edge with distance. Only the border glows, never the surface.

meta.useWhen: A row or grid of dark cards or inputs where the pointer's position should feel physical (a control panel, a studio's service list, pricing tiers).
meta.avoidWhen: Light themes with low-contrast borders; single cards (no neighbours to compare); a page already using Spotlight Card on the same cards.
